review.summary: No deployment blocker in this packet. The six Solidity files are byte-identical to kite-trace-platform/backend/contracts. Local compile is solc 0.8.30+commit.73712a01, OZ 5.4.0, optimizer 200, viaIR, Shanghai. tests/ktrace-deployment.test.ts passed: CREATE addresses nonce 1–5, runtime match including immutables, owners, 0 fees, IdentityRegistry→TrustPublication, owner-only JobLifecycleAnchor, JobEscrow token/guard, lock→accept→anchor→submit→pay, replay reject, and setTraceAnchorGuard refused after first set. Predicted addresses: IdentityRegistryV1 0xA0A902E556795E2b1B0424525e2F7535388A407F, TrustPublicationAnchorV1 0xdAC1840050f2EBfC9b92c2Cc9080d2E623E46622, JobLifecycleAnchorV2 0x64Dae9cC4063Caf71A132E3372E09807064585aB, TraceAnchorGuard 0xD1ae614A07f30d115004146F7FAf8C838A4B3fB4, JobEscrowV4 0x885164d7b9591016EcD0aAD8b6E9191752B88. Local buffered CREATE+setter gas ~7,003,531 (setter used 47,494 vs plan 100,000). Constructors only store predicted addresses; TraceAnchorGuard/JobEscrow immutables are registry/token; guard is nonce 6. Journal signs then fsyncs signed-{n}.json, recovery rebroadcasts the same raw tx, and cap is signed gasLimit×gasPrice across all six. tsc --noEmit passed. Live nonce/gas/USDT code were not queried. Production paths stay public after deploy (no pause, 0-fee register, permissionless lockFunds); that is accepted leftover, not a send gate.
next_steps: No deployment blocker. Host may prepare/send only if live nonce latest=pending=1, token code/decimals=6, empty CREATE targets, and prepare cost≤0.3 BOT.
Treat prepare “Gas cap exceeded” as the live gate. Local buffered gas is ~7.00e6; at that limit the 0.3 BOT cap allows about 43 gwei. This review did not read mainnet gas or nonce.

Send only with KTRACE_APPROVED_DIGEST equal to the prepare digest and the owner key in-process. Do not send extra txs from 0x28172e0d973fFf24651B6Ed4cA6d1007bc168C94. On uncertainty, rerun send/verify against the same signed-{1..6}.json; do not replace nonce.

After receipts: runtime, owner, registerFee=0, metadataUpdateFee=0, identityRegistry, guard.registry, escrow.traceAnchorGuard, escrow.settlementToken, escrow USDT balance 0. Do not fund USDT, register agents, create jobs, or enable backend/AA.

Residual production exposure (not a send gate): no pause; anyone can register and lockFunds after confirm; JobEscrow is unguarded until nonce 6; submit then needs an owner-published anchor; expire refunds requester and can slash executor stake.
